titulo: Brand system and motion philosophy: the DESIGN.md for your video
lead: Without a written rule, every request to the agent brings a new color and a different motion, and the pieces don't look like they're from the same brand. DESIGN.md is the file the agent reads before composing: colors, fonts, how things move, and what's forbidden. In this lesson you write yours and fail any off-brand color with one command.
objetivo: write your video's DESIGN.md and prove the composition uses only its colors and rules.

aprende.t: The four sections: Colors, Typography, Motion, and Forbidden
Tokens: the color is born in DESIGN.md and becomes a CSS variable
Motion philosophy written as a rule with a number
The checker that catches the color the agent made up

hero_alt: Color swatch cards (black, gray, white, and a yellow) and a metal type gauge on a dark table.

secoes.sub: Tap each section of the file.

nos.detalhe: Few colors, each with a role: background, surface, line, text, secondary text, and one accent used only for detail. In hex, so the checker can read it.
Family, weight, size at 1920×1080, line height, and the word limit per title.
Durations, curves (power2.out, power3.out), order (one thing at a time), how long text stays still, and how long the final frame holds. A rule with a number, not an adjective.
What the agent can't do: a color outside the list, neon, a logo drawn from memory, Math.random.
Colors enter as CSS variables (:root { --fundo: #0c0c10; … }) and the rest of the file only uses var(--fundo). Changing the brand means changing six lines.

secoes.legenda: Principles that hold for any brand: one idea at a time, light instead of lots of color, the main frame holds before it leaves.

secoes.titulo: An example DESIGN.md and the composition that obeys it
secoes.sub: The example uses INEMA's dark palette. Swap in your brand's colors, keeping the four sections.

blocos.conteudo:
# DESIGN.md — example video (Motion by code course, INEMA.CLUB)

One sentence: calm dark background, one idea at a time, light instead of color; yellow appears only as a detail.

## Cores
- fundo: #0c0c10
- superfície: #1c1c22
- linha: #3f3f47
- texto: #f4f4f5
- texto secundário: #a1a1aa
- destaque (só detalhe: um filete, um ponto, a cabeça de leitura): #e9b949

## Tipografia
- Títulos: sem serifa do sistema, peso 700, altura de linha 1,1, no máximo 6 palavras.
- Apoio: sem serifa do sistema, peso 400, 48 px em 1920x1080.
- Nenhuma palavra sozinha na última linha.

## Movimento
- Entrada de 0,5 a 0,8 s com power2.out ou power3.out; saída mais curta que a entrada, com power2.in.
- Uma coisa se move por vez; a próxima começa quando a anterior já assentou.
- Todo texto fica pelo menos 1,2 s parado e legível.
- Nada em velocidade constante (ease "none" só em barra de progresso).
- O quadro principal (título ou marca) segura pelo menos 1,5 s no fim.

## Proibido
- Cor que não está em "Cores", neon, brilho forte, gradiente colorido.
- Logo desenhado de memória: logo só do arquivo da marca.
- Math.random e Date.now na composição.

A luz decide o tom

secoes.titulo: Check the brand with one command
secoes.sub: The conferir-design.py reads the four sections and looks in the composition for every hex color that is not in Cores.

blocos.rot: Terminal · check DESIGN.md and the check
blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/formacao-cinema-ia-motion-v72/kit
export HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 NO_COLOR=1
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-motion/a4; rm -rf "$E"; mkdir -p "$E"
cp -r "$K/exemplos/a4-marca" "$E/marca"; cd "$E/marca"
python3 "$K/conferir-design.py" DESIGN.md index.html; echo "saída: $?"
npx -y hyperframes@0.8.176 check 2>&1 | grep -E "Check passed|✗|WCAG"

blocos.rot: Terminal · the error: the agent "improved" the highlight
blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/formacao-cinema-ia-motion-v72/kit
cd ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-motion/a4/marca
sed -i 's/--destaque: #e9b949/--destaque: #ff3366/' index.html   # the agent "improved" the highlight
python3 "$K/conferir-design.py" DESIGN.md index.html; echo "saída: $?"

abas.html:
OK: 4 seções · 6 cores · 5 regras de movimento · a composição usa só cores do DESIGN.md
saída: 0
  ◇ 7/7 text checks pass WCAG AA
◇  Check passed

The HyperFrames check verifies contrast (WCAG AA); the kit's checker verifies the brand. They are different gates.

abas.rot: Error caught: color out of bounds
abas.html:
FORA DA MARCA: #ff3366 (linha 9)
saída: 1

One line is enough to get the pink into the video. The checker tells you which color and on which line, and exits with code 1 so it can stop the render in a script.

texto: The RISE request starts with "read the DESIGN.md in this folder" (lesson 3).
Without that, the agent only reads it if it remembers.
Run conferir-design.py together with the check, in a single script.
Code 1 from either one stops everything.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: Which motion rule can the agent follow without guessing?
opcoes: "Modern animations like the big brands' ones."
"Fast, with energy, but not overdone at all."
perguntas.explica: A number and a curve name turn straight into code. An adjective becomes a guess, and a guess changes with every request.

perguntas.p: Why do the colors go in as CSS variables?
opcoes: Because HyperFrames doesn't accept hex in the middle of CSS.
Because a CSS variable makes the render much faster.
Because the HyperFrames lint requires a :root block.
Because changing the brand becomes changing one line per color.
perguntas.explica: Loose hex values scattered around are how the agent mixes colors. With tokens, the color changes in one place and the whole piece follows.

perguntas.p: The check passed and conferir-design.py failed it. Which one counts?
opcoes: The failure: they are gates that check different things.
The check, because it is the official HyperFrames gate.
Neither: redo the render and look at the result.
The checker, but only when the project is Remotion.
perguntas.explica: The check looks at errors, layout, motion, and contrast; it does not know what your brand is. The checker only knows the brand. A good gate has both.

itens.texto: Colors, Typography, Motion, and Forbidden, with numbers and not adjectives.
The color is born in DESIGN.md and enters the composition as a CSS variable.
